terminals.name: agent
terminals.command: cd apps/agent && set -a && source ../../.env && set +a && export POSTGRES_HOST=localhost AGENT_SHARED_KEY=kiln_dev_agent_key && exec ../../.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd apps/api && set -a && source ../../.env && set +a && export AGENT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000 AGENT_SHARED_KEY=kiln_dev_agent_key && exec npm run start:dev

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: cd apps/web && set -a && source ../../.env && set +a && exec npm run dev
